purpose_context: Automatic ingestion is the core promise of the system and it is currently non-functional. The M5-M7 auto-pipeline triggers off Papra webhooks and extracts via Papra, but M8 moved the real ingestion path to goldberg-raw + provenance manifest + direct-Docling; the auto-trigger was never migrated, so nothing watches goldberg-raw and every dropped file is silently ignored until a manual reingest. This mission builds a provenance-safe reconciler daemon that watches goldberg-raw, auto-registers provenance in the manifest, and drives the direct-Docling extract/enrich/index path, deployable always-on on Halob, replacing the dead Papra-webhook service.
purpose_tldr: Bring automatic ingestion online: a provenance-safe reconciler that watches goldberg-raw and indexes new files with no manual steps.
